base_member_text: 선언만 되고 이 파일에서 미사용: WK_Source(L62, 사용부 전체 주석화), kf,kd(L69), IM(L323), PARALLEL 의 AperG..VG(L311-313), 비병렬의 Axx..V1D,Aper..Vper(L315-320), myF 는 TRID* 출력으로만 사용
audit_member_text: Declared ESTIMATE_HUV names WK_Source, kf and kd at L62/L69 are used only in commented-out wavemaker code at L105-L112, so their retained interface intent is unclear.

base_member_text: 교차라인 의미 결함 후보: y 방향 COUPLING 분기(L457-465)가 IF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)...ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH) — 두 번째 조건도 IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH 라서 도달 불가(x 방향 대응부 L364-368 은 WEST/EAST 쌍) — IN_DOMAIN_NORTH 오기로 보임(원문 그대로 기록)
audit_member_text: The y-direction coupling boundary dispatch repeats the same predicate: `IF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` at L455 followed by `ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` at L459. The second branch, which applies the Jend/V(I,J+1) correction at L460-L461, is unreachable and appears to be a copy/paste error where a north-domain predicate was intended.

base_member_text: L391·L468 의 IF(tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK(I,J).GT.0) 는 .OR. — tmp2=0 이라도 MASK>0 이면 tmp1/tmp2 나눗셈 수행(0 나눗셈 가능): .AND. 의도였는지 미확정
audit_member_text: The nominal zero-pivot guards are ineffective for active cells. Both x and y systems test `tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK(I,J).GT.0` at L391 and L468, then divide by tmp2 at L392-L394 and L469-L471. When MASK>0 and tmp2==0, the OR condition is true and all three divisions are singular; the zero-coefficient ELSE branch is reached only when tmp2==0 and MASK<=0.

base_member_text: b1·b2·Gamma1·Gamma2·ALPHA·BETA·Eta0·Ubar0·Vbar0·EtaOld·UbarOld·VbarOld·TroughLimit·CrestLimit·FroudeCap 는 USE GLOBAL 소재 — 이 파일에 정의 없음
GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV 의 x 방향 계수에는 y 방향과 달리 Gamma2(DISP_TIME_LEFT) 비선형항이 없음(L346-350 vs L428-439) — 비대칭 의도 여부 이 파일만으로 미확정

audit_member_text: For non-CARTESIAN builds, wavemaker coordinate spacing is fixed from DX(1,1),DY(1,1) at L75-L78 and wavemaker continuity branches use those scalars throughout L89-L190, whereas the no-wavemaker branch uses DX(I,J),DY(I,J) at L203-L205. The accuracy/units assumption for a spatially varying grid inside a wavemaker is not documented.

GET_Eta_U_V_HU_HV has IMPLICIT NONE at L307 but uses I, J and tmp1/tmp2/tmp3/tmp4 throughout L340-L474 without local declarations. They must be supplied by `USE GLOBAL` or compilation fails; if supplied, loop and scratch state is module-associated rather than local, with reentrancy/thread-safety consequences not explained here.
ISTEP directly indexes ALPHA and BETA in all stage updates at L223-L282, but this file does not constrain ISTEP to the allocated coefficient range.
The Froude test divides Utotal by Fr at L522. Fr is based on `sqrt(GRAV*Max(H,MinDepthFrc))` at L521; positivity of imported GRAV and MinDepthFrc is assumed but not checked here.
